content: {"paper_id":"W4399485227","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"subspace-clustering","exact_quote":"Deep Subspace Clustering","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题直接以深度子空间聚类为任务，摘要也说明将数据映射到低维子空间后执行聚类。"},{"keyword_id":"deep-clustering","exact_quote":"deep Few-Shot Subspace Clustering Learning (FS2CL) framework","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"提出深度少样子空间聚类学习框架，利用可学习神经表示进行聚类划分。"},{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","exact_quote":"Low-Rank Representation Approximation","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题及摘要提出低秩表示近似模块，显式学习低秩表示以增强聚类内聚性。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"the subspace clustering problem with sparse-labeled information","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文以稀疏标注/部分类别仅有少量标注作为核心研究条件，属于不完整监督的弱监督设定。"},{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"learning a low-dimensional learnable subspace bases matrix assisted by a small number of labeled samples","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"利用少量有标注样本辅助学习子空间基，并在观测数据上执行聚类，结合有限监督与未标注样本。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"dimensionality-reduction","reason_zh":"虽有 low-dimensional subspace/low dimension 线索，但论文目标为子空间聚类与低秩表示，未将显式降维作为研究任务。"},{"keyword_id":"sparse-representation","reason_zh":"摘要提及 self-expression based sparsity method，但这是背景方法；本文实质提出低秩表示近似，未见以少量字典原子/基向量表达样本的稀疏表示机制。"},{"keyword_id":"class-imbalance","reason_zh":"虽有部分类别标注样本稀缺的描述，但未明确处理类别或簇样本量/描述度总量不均衡，不足以选入类别不平衡学习。"}],"input_issues":[]}
